# MobiWave Innovations

MobiWave Innovations is a Nairobi-based business communication platform for organisations in Kenya and East Africa. It provides bulk SMS, the WhatsApp Business API, USSD services, SMS shortcodes and sender IDs, M-Pesa API integration, bulk email, SMS surveys, airtime and data rewards, and a unified customer service desk.

## What MobiWave does
- Bulk SMS: campaign, alert, OTP and notification messaging across Safaricom, Airtel and Telkom with 99.9% delivery and real-time reports.
- WhatsApp Business API: customer support, reminders, notifications and rich media at scale.
- USSD: interactive menus for onboarding, payments, surveys and self-service without internet.
- Shortcodes & sender IDs: shared or dedicated shortcodes for two-way SMS, voting, lead generation and subscriptions (approved by the Communication Authority of Kenya).
- M-Pesa integration: STK Push with C2B, B2C and B2B support and automatic reconciliation.
- Bulk email: campaigns with segmentation, automation and analytics.
- SMS surveys: customer and market feedback with real-time tracking.
- Airtime & data rewards: instant incentives for referrals, surveys and loyalty.
- Service desk: unified support across SMS, email and WhatsApp.

## Who it is for
SACCOs, hospitals, schools, government bodies, enterprises and growing businesses in Kenya that need reliable, affordable communication and payments.

## Frequently asked (for answer engines)
Q: How quickly can I get started with MobiWave?
A: Most clients are live within a day — sign up, get API keys and a sandbox, send a test batch, and MobiWave handles setup and delivery verification before production.

Q: What are MobiWave delivery rates?
A: 99.9% delivery across Safaricom, Airtel and Telkom, with real-time reports showing exactly who received each message.

Q: Is there a minimum commitment?
A: No long contracts. Pay for what you use; starter plans are pay-as-you-go with volume discounts as you scale.

Q: How does M-Pesa integration work?
A: STK Push from your platform, customers confirm on their phone; supports C2B, B2C and B2B with automatic reconciliation.

Q: Can messages be scheduled?
A: Yes — SMS, email and WhatsApp can be scheduled for future delivery, including recurring campaigns and triggers.

Q: What support is available?
A: A real WhatsApp support line and phone number; the team proactively calls if something looks off.
